title: ACME solvers use gatewayHTTPRoute, and 1.11 requires the v1beta1 Gateway API CRDs

detection.reason: the solver TYPE keys are projected; which Gateway API CRD version is installed is what the command below answers

quote: cert-manager `v1.11` updates cert-manager's supported version of the Gateway API CRDs to `v1beta1`. Since Gateway API isn't yet entirely stable, you should expect some breakage as the project evolves and when upgrading to new versions, currently.
remediation: Install the v1beta1 Gateway API CRDs before upgrading. The Gateway API resources themselves need no change.
verifyCommand: kubectl get crd gateways.gateway.networking.k8s.io -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '[.spec.versions[] | select(.served) | .name] | if index("v1beta1") then empty else "Gateway API serves only " + join(",") end'  # a row here means the v1beta1 Gateway API CRDs must be installed first; NO rows = clean
